messages:
Lina Chau: quick sales->CS handoff: Nimbus Health (12mo Dedicated) signed. Contacts: diane@nimbus.health (IT), marco@nimbus.health (platform). Finance wants monthly usage CSVs.

Mike Reddy: got it. Any compliance flags? SSO? region?

Lina Chau: SSO: Okta SAML. Data residency: strict EU residency (eu-west). Traffic: baseline 15k req/day, spikes ~1.5k/min. They expect private/VPC in Q4.

Jess Park: I'll own onboarding. Need SAML metadata, expected model family, and a short runbook for spike handling. Kickoff Wed 9am PT.

Ash Kaur: Can reserve eu-west Dedicated pool. Need model (they mentioned redwood-std-psi), seq len (~512?), and KV size. Will open infra ticket.

Lina Chau: model: redwood-std-gpt4-open, seq len ~1024. Uploading SAML blob to Confluence.

Tara Nguyen: I'll create a monthly usage dashboard. Add billing account and grant me access.

Jess Park: Actions: 1) Ash open infra ticket to reserve capacity (owner: Ash, due 48h). 2) Lina provide full SAML + certs (owner: Lina, due EOD). 3) Jess run kickoff + enablement (owner: Jess, kickoff Wed 9am PT). 4) Tara create billing dashboard and CSV export (owner: Tara, due next Tue).

Ash Kaur: ENG-4201 created: provision eu-west pool (4x A100 equiv), ETA 48h. Attaching initial batching suggestion: {max_batch:24, max_latency_ms:60, kv_cache:6GB}.

deploy-bot: ENG-4201 opened by Ash Kaur.

Mike Reddy: Risks: quarterly SSO cert rotation, procurement delay for VPC. Fallback: hosted API with TLS tunnels.

Jess Park: I'll draft fallback runbook and a 2-week enablement survey (latency, docs, billing clarity). Will set product review week 3.

Lina Chau: I'll post Okta cert and billing id (NIM-7001) in Confluence tonight. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Tara Nguyen: noted, will request RBAC and slot the dashboard work.

Mike Reddy: If blockers, tag #eng-oncall and me. Closing for now.
